text:
maria: Ok team, final run-of-show for Thu 3/26 webinar — need signoffs on speakers, lead routing, and backup slides. Draft below. Please reply with :+1: or edits.

maria: RUN-OF-SHOW (45m total)
- 00:00–02:00 intro & housekeeping (maria)
- 02:00–15:00 benchmark story + methodology (sam)
- 15:00–30:00 live demo + QPS/latency tradeoffs (sam + ben)
- 30:00–40:00 panel Q&A + fallback routing discussion (panel)
- 40:00–45:00 CTA, next steps, and close (maria)

maria: Ops checklist: upload slides to GDrive, confirm captions, enable recording, set up Q&A moderator, ensure slide deck has backup 16:9 and 4:3.

jon: :+1: on timing. For leads — we need rules: SFDC campaign "Webinar-Mar26-ScaleInf" + mark source=webinar, utm_campaign=mar26-scale. High-intent (asks for enterprise demo or mentions PII) -> assign to AE queue "inbound-ai-enterprise". All other opt-ins -> nurture flow (mktg cadence).

sam: Slides link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xDemoDeckExample (still polishing). I can take benchmark methodology and demo. Will swap slides to include quant results + sampling variance note.

liz: AV notes: please confirm presenter's mic type (USB vs XLR), have local backup recording enabled, and check captioning service (Rev.ai). Rehearsal-bot will run a quick AV check 30 mins before.

ben: On routing — if a lead is tagged >$250k ARR -> add a "priority" flag and page oncall AE. Do we have a webhook to push priority leads into PagerDuty?

jon: We do not push to PD directly. Proposed flow: SFDC assignment -> HubSpot -> PagerDuty via webhook for priority only. I can add the mapping if we agree.

maria: Agree. jon please add mapping and test before Thu. Also we need the post-webinar email copy and QA link. Draft subject: "How teams cut inference cost without raising latency — recording + benchmarks"

sam: Demo credentials: temp demo account (demo_user / expires in 48h). Will add a small failover if model endpoint overloaded: fallback to quantized variant + notify ops channel.

liz: Rehearsal scheduling: @sam @ben @maria confirm availability for Tuesday 5pm PT (30m). If anyone can't make it we do a 15m dry-run earlier.

ben: Tue 5pm PT works for me.

sam: Works.

maria: Works.

rehearsal-bot: Rehearsal scheduled: Tue 5:00 PM PT -> calendar invite sent to maria,sam,ben,liz. AV check 4:30 PM PT.

jon: Email follow-up snippet (please copy/edit):
Subject: "Recording: Scaling inference — tradeoffs that actually move the needle"
Body: "Thanks for joining! Recording + slides: {recording_link}. If you'd like a custom cost estimate, reply or book time: {cal_link}. Tagged resources: benchmark repo {repo_link}."

maria: Add a short survey link (2 questions) so we can capture intent. Put survey first in email body.

sam: For the benchmark repo include a small README explaining test harness and seed values. Avoid posting raw logs with IPs.

jon: Lead owners: default assignment to SDR triage -> MQL scoring rules: (attended AND clicked recording) => +30 pts; asked demo question during Q&A => +50 pts. I'll add these to Marketo/HQ.

ben: For enterprise route: add enterprise tag + immediate AE notification via Slack DM to channel #sales-inbound with lead summary (no PII).

maria: Final asks before signoff: 1) Slides in folder by Tue 12pm PT 2) Rehearsal Tue 5pm PT 3) Lead routing test complete Wed EOD 4) Email + survey ready Wed noon

jon: I'll run routing test tomorrow, will post results here.

sam: Uploading final slides Tue 11:30am PT.

liz: I'll verify captions and recording config Tue afternoon.

rehearsal-bot: Reminder will post 24h and 1h before rehearsal.

maria: Thanks — if nobody objects, this is the run-of-show. :rocket:
